title: HR Executive
description:
**About Learntastic Solutions**
 Learntastic Solutions is a US\-headquartered online education company.
   

  

**Role at a glance**
**Position\-** 
 HR Executive
   

  

**Reporting\-** 
 Director Talent Acquisition
   

  

**Job Location\-** 
 Remote
   

  

**Employment Type\-** 
 Full time, permanent
   

  

**Timing\-** 
 5 AM \- 2 PM CST (3\.30 PM\-12\.30 AM IST/ 4\.30 PM\- 1\.30 AM IST)\-Monday\-Friday
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for an HR Executive – Generalist to keep our day\-to\-day HR running smoothly for a global, remote workforce. You will work closely with our Senior HR Manager and be the first point of contact for employees in multiple regions \- handling attendance, leave, documentation, HR queries and recruitment coordination.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on operations role with real international exposure. If you want to grow beyond a single\-country HR setup and learn how HR works across time zones, cultures and employment models, this role will give you that.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**HR operations**
* Track and maintain attendance and leave records for all employees in Keka (our HRMS)
* Keep employee data in the HRMS accurate and up to date \- new joiners, changes and exits
* Prepare and maintain employee documentation: offer letters, employment records, letters and certificates
* Coordinate with our payroll team by sharing monthly inputs (attendance, leave, joiners and exits) and checking data in Excel before processing


**Employee support**
* Respond to employee HR queries over email and Microsoft Teams, across different countries and time zones
* Manage the HR shared mailbox \- make sure every query is acknowledged, tracked and closed
* Escalate complex or sensitive matters to the HR Manager with the right context


**Recruitment and onboarding**
* Manage job postings and candidate pipelines in JazzHR, Upwork, Internal ATS
* Schedule interviews with hiring managers and candidates across time zones
* Run onboarding for new hires \- documentation, welcome communication and coordination of system access, training coordination


**Working with the HR Manager**
* Prepare HR reports and trackers as needed
* Offboarding support
* Stakeholder management
* Support the HR Manager on ongoing HR initiatives and ad hoc tasks


**What You Need**
* Graduate in any discipline (mandatory)
* Minimum 2 years of experience in an HR Generalist role
* Excellent written and spoken English
* Good working knowledge of MS Excel, Google workspace
* Strong attention to detail and the discretion to handle confidential employee information
* Able to manage several open queries at once and follow them through to closure
* Comfortable working the full shift (3:30 PM – 12:30 AM IST) consistently, Monday to Friday and (4\.30 PM \- 1\.30 AM IST\- Daylight savings)
* Your own laptop or desktop and a reliable high\-speed internet connection


**Good to have**
* MBA / PGDM in HR
* Experience supporting employees based outside India, or working in a global or multi\-country company \- a strong advantage
* Exposure to Keka, JazzHR or similar HRMS/ATS tools (not required; we will train you)


**Compensation And Benefits**
* Salary: ₹32,000 – ₹35,000 per month in\-hand, after PF and Professional Tax deductions. The final offer within this range depends on experience and interview performance
* Paid time off: 20 days of annual PTO
* Provident Fund (PF)
* Fully remote work, Monday to Friday \- no commute and weekends off
* Global HR exposure: hands\-on experience supporting a workforce across seven regions


 Powered by JazzHR

title: Adaptive Planning Consultant - Workday Success Plans
description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**
 We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun\-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Workday Success Plans Delivery Team at Workday plays a crucial role in ensuring customers maximise the value they get from their Workday products. We focus on our customers’ post go\-live journey, assuring long\-term success. We deliver a variety of programs and services ranging from feature assessments to full feature deployments to support their growing and changing business needs within Workday. At Workday, we help the world’s largest organisations adapt to what’s next by bringing finance, HR, and planning into a single enterprise cloud. We work hard, and we’re serious about what we do. But we like to have fun, too! We put people first, celebrate diversity, drive innovation, and prioritise giving back to our communities, demonstrating a commitment to corporate social responsibility. Our dedication to customer success, coupled with a vibrant and inclusive company culture, sets a strong foundation for continued growth and success at Workday.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Would you enjoy learning new things in a fast paced environment? Do you have an appetite for variety and challenging business problems to solve? Are you a great communicator who can clearly articulate and demonstrate the value of Workday solutions to our customers?
   

  

 The Workday Success Plans team works directly with customers through targeted micro\-consulting engagements to help solve their business needs using the Workday application. Responsible for acting as a trusted Workday advisor, you will have the opportunity to assist customers with how\-to questions, troubleshoot and guide customers through configuration, and provide feature demonstrations. As a Workday expert, customers will benefit from your knowledge as you share your experience, identify key considerations, and highlight standard methodologies.
   

  

 Our team of professionals have a broad and deep understanding of Workday Financials \& Adaptive Planning. In this position we are looking for expertise in the following:
   

  

 Workforce Planning Expertise
   

  

* Strong understanding of Workday Security and Business Processes
* Experience with HR Concepts such as Supervisory Organizations, Position Changes, Headcount Forecasting
* Experience in headcount modeling and analysis


 Workday Financial Planning Expertise
   

  

* Implementation experience with Workday Adaptive Planning
* Proficiency in creating and managing financial models within the platform.
* Ability to develop complex reports and dashboards using Adaptive Planning


 Data Management and Integration
   

  

* Experience with data integration between Workday Adaptive Planning and Workday HCM and/or other HCM systems.
* Proficiency in managing data imports, exports, and data validation.


 If you are passionate about the value technology can bring to an organization, love learning and want to work directly with some of the greatest companies on the planet, bring your energy and teamwork to the Workday Success Plans team!
   

  

 Primary responsibilities of this role include delivering various services to Workday Success Plans customers. To be successful, this requires:
   

  

 Conducting research to ensure understanding of customer questions and related Workday concepts.
   

  

 Delivering small scope consulting in response to customer requests; providing configuration guidance, demonstrations, considerations, tips \& tricks.
   

  

 Troubleshooting product configuration to resolve or provide optimal product configuration to meet customer business requirements.
   

  

 Clearly and effectively communicating responses and value to customers.
   

  

 Creating and delivering customer presentations on how to use Workday features to achieve business goals (Accelerator Webinars).
   

  

 Providing one\-on\-one consulting guidance to accelerate customer feature adoption (Feature Accelerator).
   

  

 Reviewing customer tenants to identify adoption opportunities (Feature Adoption Tenant Reviews).
   

  

 Completing and maintaining product expertise and Workday Certification(s) along with familiarity with Workday roadmap.
   

  

 Keeping up to date with industry practices and the ability to engage with our customers on those topics.
   

  

 Helping drive the creation of new programs to drive customer feature adoption
   

  

 In addition to delivering Workday Success Plans services, our Workday professionals will also deliver other services such as:
   

  

 Perform configuration and business requirements reviews with a detailed deliverable calling out opportunities for optimization
   

  

 Provide one\-on\-one customer configuration designs
   

  

 Deployments including full deployment of Workday features
   

  

**About You**
 2\+ years of experience with Workday Adaptive Planning implementations
   

  

 5 years of IT implementation experience
   

  

 3\+ years of software consulting experience
   

  

**Additional Qualifications:**
 1\+ years experience in Adaptive Integrations with external systems
   

  

 Workday Adaptive Planning Certification is a huge plus
   

  

 Ability to troubleshoot Adaptive Integrations to external systems
   

  

 Ability to gain a thorough understanding of Workday concepts as new features are released
   

  

 Ability to distill complex concepts into understandable presentations for our customers
   

  

 Ability to multitask and work on multiple engagements and deliverables simultaneously
   

  

 Strong critical thinking skills so as to understand complex, technical process issues and facilitate/influence decision making
   

  

 Excellent verbal and written communication skills
   

  

 Bachelor’s degree or relevant work experience required. Advanced degree preferred.
   

  

 Travel may be up to 10%
   

  

**Our Approach to Flexible Work**
 With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in\-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in\-office each week, we simply
 **spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field** 
 with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.
   

  

 Workday is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals during our application process, in order to perform one or more essential functions of their job, as well as regarding the use of AI tools for employment decision\-making to any degree. Please see below for more details including how to request an accommodation as a qualified veteran, due to a disability or for religious reasons, or as otherwise provided under applicable law.
   

  

 Workday prohibits taking adverse action against any candidate or employee for reporting a possible violation of this policy, requesting one or more work accommodations, exercising a privacy right, or cooperating in an investigation in accordance with applicable law. Any employee who retaliates against a candidate or employee for doing so may be subject to disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment, to the fullest extent allowable under applicable law.
   

  

 If you require a reasonable accommodation, you may email accommodations@workday.com, as far in advance as possible.
   

  

**Are you being referred to one of our roles? If so, ask your connection at Workday about our Employee Referral process!**
 At Workday, we value our candidates’ privacy and data security. Workday will never ask candidates to apply to jobs through websites that are not Workday Careers.
   

  

 Please be aware of sites that may ask for you to input your data in connection with a job posting that appears to be from Workday but is not.
   

  

 In addition, Workday will never ask candidates to pay a recruiting fee, or pay for consulting or coaching services, in order to apply for a job at Workday.

title: Analyst, Global Total Rewards
description:
**The Role:**
 The Analyst, Global Total Rewards supports the design, administration, analysis, and continuous improvement of 11:11 Systems’ global compensation and benefits programs. This role maintains accurate rewards data, produces insights for decision\-making, and helps deliver consistent, equitable, and market\-informed employee programs across the countries in which 11:11 Systems operates. The right person is analytical, detail\-oriented, collaborative, discreet with sensitive information, and able to translate complex data into clear recommendations for HR and business stakeholders.
   

  

 This is a full\-time remote role, based in India, reporting to the Global Benefits Manager. This role is expected to work standard UK business hours (1:30pm to 10:30pm IST).
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Support the administration of global compensation and benefits programs, including data preparation, recurring program processes, employee\-impacting changes, and documentation.
* Analyze market benchmarking, internal equity, salary structures, and compensation data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
* Coordinate annual and ad hoc compensation processes, including merit, incentive, promotion, and job change activities, ensuring accurate inputs, approvals, and timely completion.
* Maintain job architecture, job description, job title, and rewards\-related data in approved HR systems and repositories, including SharePoint and ADP as applicable.
* Prepare recurring and ad hoc reports, dashboards, and analyses for Total Rewards leadership, HR Business Partners, Finance, Payroll, and business leaders.
* Partner with HR Business Partners, People Operations, Finance, Payroll, employees, managers, benefits providers, brokers, and other external vendors to resolve questions and support effective program delivery.
* Support global benefits planning, renewals, audits, compliance activities, employee communications, and process improvements that strengthen the employee experience and operational accuracy.
* Work supportively with colleagues, operating in a manner that is consistent with 11:11’s Code of Business Ethics and Company Values
* Responsibly receive, transmit, and handle company data and information per Company data handling agreements, work procedures and policies
* Review and follow company policies and guidelines, data privacy practices, including annual compliance training certification and policy acknowledgements
* Additional duties as assigned


**Qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s or University degree in Human Resources, Finance, Business, Economics, or related field of study or equivalent years of related work experience required
* 4\+ years of demonstrated experience in compensation, benefits, total rewards, HR analytics, HR Operations or a related field required.
* Advanced excel skills including lookups, data validation, pivot tables, and the ability to analyze and reconcile large datasets required.
* Demonstrated experienced maintaining and administering key HR systems and benchmarking tools for purposes of compensation, benefits, payroll or reporting.
* In depth knowledge of global compensation and benefit practices, market benchmarking, job architecture, and employee rewards data preferred.
* ADP Workforce Now and Salary.com experience preferred.
* WorldatWork Certified Compensation Professional, Certified Benefits Professional, or other similar certification preferred.
* Communicates honestly and with professional candor.
* Delivers high quality results while embracing assumed responsibility.
* Meets internal and external customer requirements with clarity and speed.
* Works collaboratively across teams and functions and demonstrates sound judgement when handling confidential information.
* Must be legally eligible to work in assigned country without visa sponsorship


 To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential function satisfactorily. title: Manager Automation & AI
description:
Manager Automation and AI

 The AI Automation Manager sets a strategy, roadmap, and executes AI, workflow, and agent‑based solutions across HR and enterprise platforms to support evolving ways of working. This role focuses on hands‑on implementation—designing workflows, building AI agents, and automating processes to improve efficiency and employee experience. * Design, build, configure, test, and deploy AI agents that support HR processes and employee experiences.
* Lead the end\-to\-end implementation of AI\-powered HR solutions, from use case identification through deployment and adoption.

 Graduate in any field
   

  

 5 – 7 yrs with 2\-3 years experience in AI
   

  

 Experience in Copilot \& Joule Studio, Claude, SuccessFactors, WalkMe, ServiceNow and other HCM, AI \& Automation tools
